description: spark: electronics design where every claim is checked against something outside the design.

plugins.name: spark
plugins.description: Electronics design for ESP32 dev-board-plus-modules builds: from a list of modules to a tscircuit schematic and board that build, with a Wokwi diagram generated from them, checked against vendor pinouts, footprints, physics and your rules — refusing rather than guessing, and saying when a check could not look. It starts from what you own, too: /spark:drawer records your drawer, /spark:idea turns a goal in words into needs, matches each need against your drawer and spark's records and picks a part per need with you, and the picks become the requirements file that /spark:build turns into a board that builds. A draft board, not a fabrication-ready one.
